answer_4.quote: From Table  and Table , we can see that the ensemble of human annotators can lead to a massive improvement at both long and short answer criteria (from 73.4% to 87.2%, 57.5% to 75.7%).
answer_4.guideline: The comparison between model performance and human annotator ensemble suggests that human evaluation was conducted using the same criteria as the model evaluation, namely long answer and short answer accuracy.
